description: This file is a React component ('Hero') for a portfolio website built with Next.js and TypeScript. It includes a helper function 'safeCopyToClipboard' for copying text to the clipboard and the main 'Hero' component rendering the hero section with profile info, social links, and CTA buttons.

methods.name: safeCopyToClipboard
methods.description: Asynchronously copies provided text to the clipboard, using secure API with a fallback approach. Returns true if copy succeeds, false otherwise.

methods.name: Hero
methods.description: React functional component rendering the hero section of the portfolio, including profile image, name, description, social links, and contact button.
